# codemode_optin.txt provenance

- **Source:** the Code Mode first-use opt-in dialog ("Code Mode
  (experimental)", options `No, start without it` / `Yes, turn on Code
  Mode`, footer `Enter to confirm · Esc to start without it`). The options are
  unnumbered, so `IsPrompt` needs its own shape for it.
- **Version:** Claude Code `2.1.325`.
- **Captured:** 2026-11-15.
- **Pane:** a live capture in a private scratch tmux server, started with
  `claude --settings <env overlay> --permission-mode auto`. The owner had not
  accepted the opt-in, so the dialog appeared on first launch. The file is the
  capture verbatim, trailing blank rows included.
